about: T-447 pair 3 (tools/gbalandmarks.py, built 2026-10-26): the REVIEW BOARD at the top of the plateau -- four vessels I-IV, red, yellow, black, pale, in a near-black hall under the bench slab, the porch in dark stone round the kept door -- and ERRATA in SLATE, the struck chalk line and red caret on its slate roof (the chalk a scrawl, no word), and the annex's pinned card; walking into each. Only goto, holds and shots -- no walker steps, so nobody stands on a doormat (T-451). Watch held at day, clear weather, summer. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
